description: One voice agent, identified by its platform's own id: its own text (context) and the blocks it uses, in order. Written as agents/<id>.yaml.

id.description: Alias used everywhere else in sop: the file name without .yaml. Set automatically.
id.title: Id

livekit.description: LiveKit agent_name. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs, retell.
livekit.title: Livekit

vapi.description: Vapi assistant id. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs, retell.
vapi.title: Vapi

elevenlabs.description: ElevenLabs agent_id. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs, retell.
elevenlabs.title: Elevenlabs

retell.description: Retell agent_id. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs, retell.
retell.title: Retell

context.description: Text only this agent gets. It goes first in the prompt, before every block.
context.title: Context

blocks.description: Instruction, SOP and group ids, in prompt order. A group expands in place. Each block may appear once.
blocks.title: Blocks

variables.description: Values for {{name}} placeholders. Override the defaults in sop.yaml.
variables.title: Variables

title: sop agent: agents/<id>.yaml
